patch_description: This replaces recursive Kalman state updates with a causal multi-scale robust local-polynomial regression filter. At every endpoint it fits both short- and long-horizon weighted local linear models, using Huber reweighting to reject impulsive noise. The short model supplies low-lag dynamics while the long model suppresses volatility; their blend is selected from local model agreement and estimated noise. A directional hysteresis controller requires persistent evidence before committing weak reversals, substantially reducing noise-induced slope changes without delaying large genuine turns. Output alignment and all public function inputs/outputs remain unchanged.
